designationHistory.name: National Desert Storm and Desert Shield Memorial
designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the National Desert Storm Memorial Association to build a memorial on federal land in Washington, D.C., to those who served in Operations Desert Storm and Desert Shield.
designationHistory.note: A 2017 law (Public Law 115-18) approved a site near the National Mall; that is a siting action, not a designation, and is not listed. The memorial association changed the name's word order in December 2022; no government action on the name was found.

sources.name: 40 U.S.C. 8903 notes (Cornell LII), commemorative works list
